desc.en: CDN for bootstrap, bootswatch and fontawesome.io
desc.zh: 用于 bootstrap、bootswatch 和 fontawesome.io 的 CDN

desc.en: Up to 5 TB per month of Free CDN traffic, 19 Core PoPs , 1 Domain and Universal SSL.
desc.zh: 每月最多 5 TB 的免费 CDN 流量、19 个核心 PoP、1 个域名和通用 SSL。

desc.en: Simple. Fast. Reliable. Content delivery at its finest. cdnjs is a free and open-source CDN service trusted by over 11% of all websites, powered by Cloudflare.
desc.zh: 简单、快速、可靠。极致的内容交付。cdnjs 是一项免费开源 CDN 服务，由 Cloudflare 提供支持，受到超过 11% 的网站信赖。

desc.en: The Google Hosted Libraries is a content distribution network for the most popular Open Source JavaScript libraries
desc.zh: Google Hosted Libraries 是一个面向最流行开源 JavaScript 库的内容分发网络

desc.en: Global content delivery network, 1 TB and 1 million requests per month free and free DNS hosting
desc.zh: 全球内容分发网络，每月免费提供 1 TB 流量和 100 万次请求，并 提供免费 DNS 托管

desc.en: A free, fast, and reliable open-source CDN. Supports npm, GitHub, WordPress, Deno, and more.
desc.zh: 免费、快速、可靠的开源 CDN。支持 npm、GitHub、WordPress、Deno 等。

desc.en: The Microsoft Ajax CDN hosts popular third-party JavaScript libraries such as jQuery and enables you to easily add them to your Web application
desc.zh: Microsoft Ajax CDN 托管 jQuery 等流行的第三方 JavaScript 库，让你可以轻松将它们添加到 Web 应用中

desc.en: Free DDoS protection and SSL certificate
desc.zh: 免费 DDoS 防护和 SSL 证书

desc.en: Free cloud Secure Web Gateway. Free plan includes up to 5 users and 1 GB per day.
desc.zh: 免费云安全 Web 网关。免费套餐支持最多 5 名用户和每天 1 GB。

desc.en: A modern replacement of **rawgit.com** which simply hosts file using Cloudflare
desc.zh: **rawgit.com** 的现代替代品，直接使用 Cloudflare 托管文件

desc.en: The 100% Native ES Module JavaScript CDN. Free for 1 million requests per domain per month.
desc.zh: 100% 原生 ES Module JavaScript CDN。每域名每月 100 万次请求以内免费。

desc.en: CDN for Git repos (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), WordPress-related assets, and images
desc.zh: 面向 Git 仓库（GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket）、WordPress 相关资源和图片的 CDN

desc.en: Stellate is a blazing-fast, reliable CDN for your GraphQL API and free for two services.
desc.zh: Stellate 是一款极速、可靠的 GraphQL API CDN，两个服务以内免费。

desc.en: Proxy for Packagist and GitHub. Never fail CD. Free for personal use, one developer, no support
desc.zh: Packagist 和 GitHub 的代理。让 CD 永不失败。个人使用免费，限一名开发者，不提供支持
npm 上一切内容的 CDN

desc.en: An image cache & resize service. Manipulate images on the fly with a worldwide cache.
desc.zh: 图片缓存与缩放服务。借助全球缓存即时处理图片。
